english.title: Fail to give name / address to CSO / CSV believing that relevant offence committed

(A)_[officer]_
(B)_[volunteer]_

english.legislation: Contrary to paragraph 3(1) and (2) of Schedule 3C to the Police Reform Act 2002.

english.notes:
(i) This replaces the offence in paragraph 1A of Schedule 4 to the Police Reform Act 2002; for offences committed prior to 1st December 2017.
(ii) Relevant offences are listed in paragraph 3(3) of Schedule 3C to the Police Reform Act 2002 and include listed byelaws.
(ii) The relevant offence has to be committed in the relevant police area, unless it is a relevant licensing offence, paragraph 3 of Schedule 3C to the Police Reform Act 2002.

other.powersofarrest:
Arrest without warrant(constable)
CSOs/CSVs designated under section 38 of the Police Reform Act 2002 have no power to arrest, see section 38(6B) and paragraph 1 of Schedule 3B (excluded powers); however, there is a power to detain the person for a maximum of 30 minutes pending the arrival of a constable, see paragraph 7 of Schedule 3C to the Police Reform Act 2002.
